issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand' (i.e., a square of 25,000 x 25,000), and 'a fourth' (רְבִיעִית) of it is to be raised as the holy offering. The Chinese renders '從二十五千取五分之一' ('take one-fifth from 25,000'), which misstates the number (one-fifth instead of a fourth) and misrepresents the dimension/quantity structure.
